title: Vanilla essentials +
description: This Modpack adds all the Features and all the Performance you need for playing Vanilla Minecraft
body:
# Describtion
Vanilla Essentials + doesn’t change Minecraft itself — it changes the way you play it.
This pack is built around the idea of keeping the vanilla game intact while enhancing the overall experience with carefully chosen mods, that enhance performance, menus, animations, sounds etc. this modpack also adds camera features and mods that make minecraft more immersive.

## Whats inside?
Inside the pack you’ll find set of lightweight yet powerful mods:

<details>
<summary>Mods</summary>

- [3d Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) makes the second layer of skins 3d
- [AmbientSounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) adds ambient sounds to caves and forests
- [Apple Skin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) gives you clear information about hunger and saturation
- [Better Statics Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats) make the Statics more intuitive
- [Camera Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-utils) adds nice camera features like zoom
- [Cave Dust](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dust) adds dust in caves for a more immersive gameplay
- [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) let you see easier who you are chatting with
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) adds connected textures for glass etc. (needs to be activated in reccourcepacks)
- [Cubes without borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders) adds borderless F11 Screen that let you use other apps without Minecraft closing
- [Distant Horizions](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) lets you see farther without big performance impact
- [Eating Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/eating-animation) makes eating more intresting to look at

all the other mods are following in the next days...

</details>


## What Mods are also included? 
Of course, [Simply Performance +](https://modrinth.com/modpack/simply-performance+) — my own performance modpack — is fully included in every version. This means you get all the optimizations and performance tweaks that make Minecraft run smoother, seamlessly integrated into Vanilla Essentials.

### Summary
Together, these mods create a pack that respects the vanilla game while elevating how you experience it. It’s not about changing Minecraft — it’s about making every moment in Minecraft feel better, clearer, and more enjoyable.
